title: IGY listening posts for U-2 overflights
summary: Jan Lundquist tells of IGY listening posts for U-2 overflights, about 1957 at Worldwide, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: That gave Townshend an opportunity to travel around and set up these, what we would call listening post, for the U-2s as they overflew Soviet Russia.

plain: A researcher named Jan Lundquist, appearing in a documentary about the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, says that the International Geophysical Year, a worldwide science effort in 1957, gave Brown a reason to travel the globe. According to Lundquist, Brown used those trips to set up listening posts for the U-2, an American spy plane flying over the Soviet Union, which would mean this science project also hid secret intelligence work.
